hook: Campylobacter's flagellar motor has exceptionally high torque and a linear torque-speed decline

readout.label: Stall torque, C. jejuni flagellar motor

summary: Single-motor measurements of Campylobacter jejuni showed a stall torque far above model bacteria and a roughly linear drop in torque with speed, unlike the biphasic curve in E. coli. Inferred active stator units averaged 11, fewer than the 17 seen structurally, and activity recovered quickly after proton motive force collapse. The linear trend was seen only over the measured speed range, and stator counts are inferred.
title: Torque generation and regulation in the flagellar motor of Campylobacter jejuni differ from those of model organisms
